newsitem.title: UK: UK housing market vulnerable to rate rise -- CML.
newsitem.headline: UK housing market vulnerable to rate rise -- CML.

text.p: A rise in British mortgage rates and further erosion of tax relief on home loans could jeopardise the current housing market recovery, Peter White, chairman of the Council of Mortgage Lenders (CML), said.

"Whichever government gets elected during the year, it is vital that the signs of recovery are not jeopardised by a "double whammy' of both rising mortgage rates and a reduction in the level of government support for home ownership," he said in a speech.
White said the prospects for the housing market were generally positive in 1997, but the recovery could not sustain sudden large increases in interest rates.
He cited recent increases in housing transactions, lower unemployment rates and low interest rates as reasons for optimism.
